✳ 01 / About TGTS

Welcome to Telangana
Technology Services.

Telangana Technology Services is a specialised government organisation supporting departments, public institutions and public sector undertakings with their technology needs.

From defining requirements to procuring systems and supporting implementation, TGTS connects public purpose with practical technology expertise.

Our purpose

A stronger digital
foundation.
For everyone.

Expertise across technology planning, procurement and e-governance implementation.
